properties.description:
- Node = identity plus components; each component instance has one owner and stable identity, with repeated types allowed and typed properties.
- View = cached predicate membership; predicates belong to their owners, can be shared/composed and introduce no contributor vocabulary into the engine.
- Use lazy dependency-aware invalidation and scoped observers; validated operations preserve consistent reads and typed edge requirements.
- Build the engine foundation first, then replace existing node types and consumers; keep intermediate commits and agent reviews, with one final human inspection.
properties.title: Record component containers and event-driven view architecture
